name: Wing Suite
author: wingdevs

sections.description:
Wing Suite is a powerful bundle plugin designed to provide essential tools to enhance your WordPress site. It starts with two feature-rich modules — Dark Mode for improved accessibility and aesthetics, and AJAX Search for lightning-fast, real-time search results. Built with performance and scalability in mind, Wing Suite is your foundation for future expansion, as new modules will be seamlessly integrated over time.

Initial Modules Included:

  • Dark Mode: Add a beautiful, customizable dark theme to your website. Includes multiple style presets and flexible customization options.
  • AJAX Search: Deliver instant, relevant search results without page reloads. Enhance user experience and navigation with fast, dynamic search.

Key Features:

  • Modular Architecture: Activate only the modules you need. Keep your site lean and efficient.
  • Performance Optimized: Every feature is built to work smoothly without slowing down your website.
  • Customizable Settings: Fine-tune each module to match your design, content, and audience preferences.
  • Future-Proof: Wing Suite will continue to grow with additional modules for marketing, engagement, and productivity.
  • Easy to Use: A unified, user-friendly dashboard to manage all active modules from one place.

Why Choose Wing Suite?

Instead of installing multiple separate plugins, Wing Suite brings essential features together in a clean, modular package. Whether you want to enhance your site’s look, improve search functionality, or prepare for upcoming tools, Wing Suite helps you achieve it with fewer plugins, fewer updates, and better performance.
sections.installation:
Quick Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Wing Suite”.
  4. Click Install, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Wing Suite WordPress Plugin.
  2. Extract the zip file.
  3. Upload the contents to the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate from the Plugins page.
sections.faq:
1. What modules are included in Wing Suite right now?

The initial release includes two modules — Dark Mode and AJAX Search. More modules will be added in future updates.

2. Can I disable modules I don’t need?

Yes! Wing Suite is modular. You can enable or disable modules anytime from the main dashboard.

3. Will adding more modules slow down my site?

No. Only the active modules will load their assets and functionality.

4. Can I customize the Dark Mode appearance?

Absolutely. Wing Suite includes multiple style presets and custom color settings to match your brand and design preferences.

5. Is AJAX Search compatible with custom post types?

Yes, AJAX Search supports posts, pages, and custom post types. You can control which ones are included in search results.

6. How often will new modules be released?

We plan to release new modules regularly. Check the “Future Updates” tab inside the plugin for upcoming features.
